Dubai Municipality restructures 20 services to deliver a simpler, more seamless customer experience. The development process included revising the operating models of 13 services through integration with other services, conversion into procedures or reports, or discontinuation where a standalone service was no longer required. 7 specialised services were transferred to the Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority, providing greater clarity of responsibilities and reducing duplication across government entities.
